purpose: Launch an isolated vLLM backend that selects the rebuilt oneDNN sidecar _xpu_C extension via a temporary overlay package, while the normal Python package files still come from the local vllm-xpu-kernels source checkout.

overlay.mechanism: Temporary vllm_xpu_kernels package uses pkgutil.extend_path and symlinks only the rebuilt _xpu_C.abi3.so so import order selects the sidecar extension first.

oneapi_runtime.required_reason: The IntelLLVM 2026.0 sidecar build requires oneAPI runtime library paths, including libsycl.so.9, when imported outside the normal installed package path.

validation.deferred_reason: The current live TP4 backend still occupies essentially all four B70s, so launching a second TP4 backend would compete with production service VRAM.

next_gate: Stop or move the live TP4 backend intentionally.
Launch the script in tmux on port 18081.
Wait for /health and run one deterministic small completion.
Inspect the sidecar JSONL file for descriptor and grouped-offset stats.
Confirm the endpoint output still comes from the accepted xpu_fused_moe path.
Restore the accepted backend and rerun provenance and canary checks.
